bestBets.overview: The speed is unclear. NO HESITATION was my pick of the new-comers but all have shown some ability. GILGEOUS has been dodging wet tracks of late, which is no surprise looking at his trails and jump outs. HANDSOME MISSILE resumes and he should be breaking through very quickly this time in. He placed 4 of his 5 starts last prep with the miss being an inconclusive effort on a H9. There's plenty of depth to his maiden form. On the small amount of evidence so far, the drier the track, the better the chance. MERITATEN is very fit and doing well on heavy tracks. SPEX has jumped out well for her return. She wasn't far away at both her starts. Not much went right here before the break. LEVENS HALL has jumped out well. He returns gelded after Craig Williams suggested he did not race genuinely at Sandown. SANDZIBAR debuted well at Warracknabeal. He got back after an awkward beginning. Jump outs would suggest he can race handily if he jumps cleanly.

raceTips.comment:
Meritaten hit the line strongly last start at Wodonga from a long way back. Her racing pattern is the concern here however she has a race fitness advantage over many of her rivals and should be strong late.
Spex showed talent in two starts last preparation and has jumped out like she's improved. She might be able to measure up at a nice price.
Handsome Missile's best form is arguably the best in the race and the stable is flying. I didn't love his jumpout. 
Sandzibar hit the line nicely on debut and looks better suited on the bigger track. 
Levens Hall resumes gelded for a leading stable and no surprise to see him win off what he showed on debut with the potential he's improved now gelded.

bestBets.overview: After Diamond Eye's 0-62 win at Seymour Thursday, it's difficult to look beyond the pair that finished 2nd and 3rd behind her at Bendigo. SKYDREAM tried hard to hold off Diamond Eye with ANNATORIA working home nicely into 3rd. Given ANNATORIA is almost 3 times the odds of SKYDREAM, happy to be with her. Don't think there's much doubt she'll run a strong 1400m.  APACHE SUNRISE is very fit and drawn for a good trail. JOELY has jumped out well enough to consider on debut. PATCHSON and ROCK THE VENDI look like 1400m might suit them.

raceTips.comment:
Patchson comes through a strong race at Seymour in which he finished fourth, with subsequent winners either side of him in second and fifth. He looks suited rising in distance and can roll forward and race on the speed up to 1400m. 
I'm surprised there's such a discrepancy between Annatoria and Skydream in the early betting given the former potentially has more upside and was finishing stronger than her last start. 
Rock The Vendi had jumped out well prior to her debut where she raced wide without cover. She can improve sharply rising in distance at her second start. 
Sunday Vendetta was strong late on debut in a handy maiden and can improve sharply rising in distance, particularly if he jumps with the field.

bestBets.overview: Assuming gate 1 is no disadvantage then LONSTAR looks a worthy favourite. Back to the 1000m looks the key to his chances. The Seymour 2nd is good form for this. raceTips.comment:
Lonstar was excellent behind the in form Scoobartie two starts ago at Seymour. I suspect 1200m was too far for her last start and dropping back in distance and down in class she looks well placed.
Epic Centre looks one of the two likely leaders. He usually improves with racing but if he's forward enough to run to his best he can win.
